title: US20250136541A1: N-epsilon-long chain acyl lysine crystal production method and composition containing said crystals

title: EP3928837A1: Powder and cosmetic preparation
facts: Example1 mixes4gLL with16g corn starch using ball milling100rpm15h; surface association observed microscopically; corn-starch compression modulus reported2.9e8Pa with n5.
